```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/maple-mono@5.2.5/index.min.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>

<style>
  .ti-outer {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 1em 0;
    border: 1.5px solid #5654A2;
    border-radius: 14px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .ti-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 10px;
    background: #5654A2;
    padding: 10px 16px;
  }

  .ti-header-icon {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: rgba(248, 247, 240, 0.2);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .ti-header-icon svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .ti-header-text {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #F8F7F0;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .ti-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    background: #F8F7F0;
  }

  .ti-col {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    border-right: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
  }

  .ti-col:last-child { border-right: none; }

  .ti-col-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    background: #EEEDF8;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.8em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #5654A2;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .ti-col-header svg {
    width: 13px;
    height: 13px;
    color: #5654A2;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .ti-tool {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .ti-tool:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .ti-tool:hover { background: #F0EFF8; }
  .ti-tool:hover .ti-tool-icon { background: #F8F7F0; }

  .ti-tool-icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: #EEEDF8;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .ti-tool-icon a {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .ti-tool-icon svg {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    color: #5654A2;
    stroke-width: 1.8;
  }

  .ti-tool-icon img {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 5px;
  }

  .ti-tool-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }

  .ti-tool-name {
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    color: #5654A2;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }

  .ti-tool-desc {
    font-size: 0.82em;
    color: #564232;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .ti-pick {
    display: inline-block;
    font-family: 'Maple Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.7em;
    color: #9896CC;
    background: #EEEDF8;
    border: 1px solid #D4D3EE;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 1px 5px;
    margin-left: 4px;
    vertical-align: middle;
  }

  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .ti-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .ti-col { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #D4D3EE; }
    .ti-col:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  }
</style>

<div class="ti-outer">
  <div class="ti-header">
    <div class="ti-header-icon"><i data-lucide="monitor"></i></div>
    <span class="ti-header-text">Terminals & IDEs</span>
  </div>
  <div class="ti-grid">
    <div class="ti-col">
      <div class="ti-col-header">
        <i data-lucide="terminal"></i> Terminals
      </div>
      <div class="ti-tool">
        <div class="ti-tool-icon"><i data-lucide="terminal"></i></div>
        <div class="ti-tool-info">
          <div class="ti-tool-name">macOS Terminal</div>
          <div class="ti-tool-desc">Built-in, good enough for most use</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="ti-tool">
        <div class="ti-tool-icon"><a href="https://github.com/tw93/Kaku" target="_blank"><img src="resources/kaku-logo.png" /></a></div>
        <div class="ti-tool-info">
          <div class="ti-tool-name"><a href="https://github.com/tw93/Kaku" target="_blank">Kaku</a> <span class="ti-pick">my pick</span></div>
          <div class="ti-tool-desc">Minimal, keyboard-driven terminal</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ti-col">
      <div class="ti-col-header">
        <i data-lucide="code-2"></i> IDEs
      </div>
      <div class="ti-tool">
        <div class="ti-tool-icon">
          <a href="https://code.visualstudio.com" target="_blank">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#007ACC" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
              <path d="M23.15 2.587L18.21.21a1.494 1.494 0 0 0-1.705.29l-9.46 8.63-4.12-3.128a.999.999 0 0 0-1.276.057L.327 7.261A1 1 0 0 0 .326 8.74L3.899 12 .326 15.26a1 1 0 0 0 .001 1.479L1.65 17.94a.999.999 0 0 0 1.276.057l4.12-3.128 9.46 8.63a1.492 1.492 0 0 0 1.704.29l4.942-2.377A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 24 20.06V3.939a1.5 1.5 0 0 0-.85-1.352zm-5.146 14.861L10.826 12l7.178-5.448v10.896z"/>
            </svg>
          </a>
        </div>
        <div class="ti-tool-info">
          <div class="ti-tool-name"><a href="https://code.visualstudio.com" target="_blank">VS Code</a></div>
          <div class="ti-tool-desc">Widely used, great extension ecosystem</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="ti-tool">
        <div class="ti-tool-icon">
          <a href="https://positron.posit.co" target="_blank"><img src="resources/positron-icon.png" /></a>
        </div>
        <div class="ti-tool-info">
          <div class="ti-tool-name"><a href="https://positron.posit.co" target="_blank">Positron</a> <span class="ti-pick">my pick</span></div>
          <div class="ti-tool-desc">Built for data science (R & Python)</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  if (typeof lucide !== 'undefined') lucide.createIcons();
</script>
```
